name: UndoRecord
description: Provides an entry point into the undo stack.
remarks: Use the UndoRecord object to create and modify custom undo records in the Word undo stack.
example:
Dim objUndo As UndoRecord
Set objUndo = Application.UndoRecord

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Word application. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified UndoRecord object.

properties.name: IsRecordingCustomRecord
properties.description: Returns a Boolean that specifies whether a custom undo action is being recorded. Read-only.

properties.name: CustomRecordName
properties.description: Returns a String that specifies the entry that appears on the undo stack when all custom undo actions have completed. Read-only.

properties.name: CustomRecordLevel
properties.description: Returns a Long that specifies the number of custom undo action calls that are currently active. Read-only.

methods.name: StartCustomRecord
methods.description: Initiates the creation of a custom undo record.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the custom undo record. This string is limited to 64 characters. If a longer string is supplied, the string is truncated to 64 characters.

methods.name: EndCustomRecord
methods.description: Completes the creation of a custom undo record.
